name: Snap-start
description: 用 Pixabay 高清美图作为 Chrome 新标签页起始页，每次打开随机展示一张图片。

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://pixabay.com https://cdn.pixabay.com https://api.open-meteo.com https://api.bigdatacloud.net https://devapi.qweather.com https://api.ip.sb; img-src 'self' data: https://cdn.pixabay.com https://pixabay.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'
